S69.01.note: The Chat | Work switch renders only for a paid account with a project picker (canUseAgiWork and projectPicker in ChatComposerNew.tsx); the run itself was not traced.
steps: Sign in with a paid account and open Chat.
Look at the message box for the two-part switch with "Chat" and "Work" (at narrow widths only icons show).
Click "Work" so it is pressed.
Type a multi-step goal (for example "List three files in my project and summarise each") and send.
Compare: the conversation runs in Work mode with a plan and tool steps, as in Expected.
S69.01.where: Chat page (sign in, then Chat) > composer toggle at the right of the message box: click "Work"

S69.02.needs: a resizable browser window or phone width
S69.02.note: Layout tiers are defined in apps/web/shared/components/layout/app-shell-layout.ts (768px and 1024px breakpoints).
steps: Open the web app and make the window narrower than 768px (or use a phone-width browser emulation).
Click "Open navigation" in the header; the drawer slides in.
Click any item in the drawer; the drawer closes.
Widen the window to 1024px or more; the sidebar stays open beside the content.
Compare: drawer below 768px, icon rail on portrait tablet widths, persistent sidebar on wide windows, as in Expected.
S69.02.where: Resize the browser window: under 768px tap "Open navigation" in the header; 768px to 1023px in portrait uses the icon rail; 1024px and wider keeps the sidebar open

S69.03.note: The URL is replaced after the first send in WebChatPage.tsx (router.replace to the conversation href).
steps: Click "New chat" and type a first message, then send it.
Read the address bar: it changes from /chat to /chat/<id> after the send.
Open another conversation from the Sidebar, then copy the address.
Open the copied address in a new tab.
Compare: the same conversation loads from its own URL, as in Expected.
S69.03.where: Sidebar > New chat > send a first message, then read the address bar; open a conversation from the Sidebar and read the address bar

S69.04.note: Back/Forward behaviour depends on router navigation in WebChatPage.tsx; no visible control exists in the app for it.
steps: Open conversation A from the Sidebar, then open conversation B.
Click the browser Back button; conversation A should load.
Click the browser Forward button; conversation B should load.
Compare: each step opens the conversation its URL names, as in Expected.
S69.04.where: Sidebar > open conversation A, then open conversation B > browser Back and Forward buttons

S69.05.note: Draft storage is in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/composer-draft-storage.ts; this checks same-browser reload only.
steps: Open a conversation and type text in the message box without sending.
Press Cmd+R to reload the page.
Compare: the same conversation is open and the unsent text is back in the message box, as in Expected.
Reload once more to confirm it still holds in the same browser.
S69.05.where: Open a conversation, type an unsent draft in the message box, then reload the browser page (Cmd+R)

steps: Open Chat in the browser.
In Finder, select a file and drag it over the chat window.
Look for the overlay titled "Drop files here".
Release the file over the window, then check the message box for an attached file.
Compare: the overlay appeared and the dropped file is attached, as in Expected.
S69.06.where: Chat page > drag a file from Finder onto the chat window

S69.07.needs: a file to upload and a clipboard
S69.07.note: Code-block paste and the Strikethrough Markdown case were not traced here.
steps: Copy a line of text in Notes, click the message box and press Cmd+V; the text appears.
Copy a file in Finder and press Cmd+V in the message box; check that it is attached.
Send any message, then hover over the reply and click "Copy message".
Paste the result into Notes with Cmd+V.
Compare: the pasted text and files appear, and the reply text is on the clipboard, as in Expected.
S69.07.where: Message box (composer) > paste with Cmd+V; reply under a message > hover and click "Copy message"

S69.08.needs: a microphone and a browser that asks for permission
S69.08.note: The refusal text is in apps/web/features/chat/lib/live-voice-session.ts. No camera request was found in the traced files.
steps: Click the microphone button next to the message box.
Allow the browser's microphone prompt when it appears.
Deny the prompt on a second try (or block it in site settings) and click the button again.
Compare: a refusal shows "Microphone access was denied. Allow the microphone to use voice mode." and voice starts again after access is allowed, as in Expected.
S69.08.where: Message box (composer) > microphone button "Start voice input" (click it)

labels.text: Cloud code execution and file creation

S69.10.needs: a model that can run code on this deployment
S69.10.note: The sandbox description names GitHub, npm and PyPI only; E2B was not confirmed in the traced files, and the control that opens Settings was not traced.
steps: Open Settings and choose Capabilities.
Turn on the switch "Cloud code execution and file creation".
Go back to Chat, type /code followed by a request (for example "/code print the sum of 2 and 3") and send.
Turn the switch off and repeat the /code request.
Compare: with it on the code runs in the sandbox; with it off the server refuses, as in Expected.
S69.10.where: Settings > Capabilities > "Cloud code execution and file creation" switch; in Chat type /code in the message box and send

S69.13.needs: a browser that supports web push and a Work run
S69.13.note: The notice says "Enable separately in each browser"; the closed-tab delivery depends on apps/web/public/sw.js and was not run.
steps: Open Settings and choose Notifications.
Turn on the switch "Agent run updates" and allow the browser notification prompt.
Start a Work run that takes a while, then close the tab.
Wait for the run to finish and watch for a system notification.
Compare: a notification arrives after the run ends with the tab closed, as in Expected.

S69.17.note: Artifact and file downloads were not traced; the Export entry is in the conversation options menu, not the chat header.
steps: Open a conversation with a few messages.
Click "Conversation options" and choose "Export…".
In the "Export Chat History" dialog, pick a format: Markdown, PDF, Word Document, HTML or JSON.
Click the export button and check the file in Downloads.
Compare: the file downloads in the chosen format with the conversation in it, as in Expected.
S69.17.where: Open a conversation > "Conversation options" menu > "Export…" > choose a format > Export

labels.text: Voice input not supported in this browser

S69.18.needs: a browser that lacks microphone capture (hard to reach on a current browser)
S69.18.note: Other capability checks (web push in apps/web/features/notifications/lib/web-push-client.ts) were not traced to a visible control.
steps: Open the app in a browser where navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia is missing.
Look at the microphone button; it appears dimmed.
Click it; a hint appears for a few seconds.
Compare: the hint says "Voice input is not supported in this browser" instead of a failure, as in Expected.
S69.18.where: Message box (composer) > microphone button "Start voice input" in a browser without microphone support (click it)

labels.text: This browser is too old to run AGI.

S69.19.needs: an old browser or JavaScript turned off
S69.19.note: The JavaScript-off notice ("AGI needs JavaScript.") is in the same file and the banner is in apps/web/app/layout.tsx.
steps: Open the app in a browser too old to meet the feature checks, or turn JavaScript off and reload.
Look at the top of the page for the notice.
Compare: the notice says to open AGI in a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, or to turn JavaScript on, as in Expected.
S69.19.where: Open AGI in an unsupported browser (too old) or with JavaScript off; the notice appears at the top of the page

S69.20.needs: a second browser profile or private window, and a shared conversation
S69.20.note: The link preview title comes from generateMetadata in apps/web/app/share/[token]/page.tsx; the link preview was not checked in a real browser.
steps: Open a conversation and click "Conversation options", then "Share…".
Create a share link in "Share conversation" and copy it.
Open the link in a private window (signed out); check the page loads with the conversation.
Scroll to the bottom and find "Report infringement or impersonation".
Open a link that has expired or was revoked; check for "Shared conversation unavailable". Compare with Expected.
S69.20.where: Open a conversation > "Conversation options" > "Share…" > create the share link, copy it, then open it signed out
